name: Zebedee Coltrin
role: Early elder and president of the Seventy
dateNote: Section 52 sent him to Missouri on 6 June 1831; he became a Seventy president in February 1835.
importance: Zebedee Coltrin was baptized in Ohio in January 1831, and section 52 sends him to Missouri with Levi W. Hancock. He attended the School of the Prophets in 1833 and marched with the 1834 camp to Missouri. In 1835 he became one of the presidents of the Seventy. He went west with the 1847 pioneer company and died at Spanish Fork, Utah.
connections: Section 52 pairs him with Levi W. Hancock; in 1832 he travelled briefly with Jesse Gause.

sources.title: Zebedee Coltrin, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: Career checked on JSP. JSP gives no death date; Wikipedia gives 21 July 1887, the same date as the Deseret News obituary JSP cites, so the exact day is uncertain.
